sources.title: Sigma correlation rules specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Wazuh FIM：掃描間隔與短暫變更可見性
related.titleEn: Wazuh FIM: scan intervals and transient-change visibility
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四列事件、窗口真值表、後端查詢差異及跨租戶反例，將實驗窗口定義列於每張結果表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver four event rows, interval truth tables, backend-query differences and cross-tenant counterexamples, printing the interval definition with results.
related.difference: 為10項檔案變更列出開始、結束、前後雜湊與掃描時刻，區分未觀察到和確定沒有變更。
related.differenceEn: Record start, end, before/after hashes and scan times for ten changes, distinguishing unobserved changes from established absence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課使用(t−W,t]，而非假定所有後端都一致；tenant必須加入分組以避免相同帳號名跨租戶合併。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 租戶A同一user在0、59、60秒各有一筆，租戶B在60秒也有同名user；於t=60、W=60評估。 A窗口為(0,60]，只計59與60兩筆；B事件不得加入A的計數。
排程掃描只能比對取樣時刻的狀態；本課比例是給定時間線可見率，不是產品普遍偵測率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 掃描在0與300秒；10項變更皆從120秒開始，其中6項持續到360秒、4項在180秒還原。 300秒掃描看見6項，樣本可見率6/10=60%；4項還原不代表從未發生。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: This exercise uses (t−W,t], without assuming universal backend behavior; tenant belongs in the grouping key. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Tenant A has same-user events at 0,59,60 seconds; tenant B has a same-named user at 60; evaluate at t=60 with W=60. A’s window is (0,60], counting only the events at 59 and 60; tenant B contributes nothing to A.

Scheduled scans compare sampled states; the resulting fraction belongs to this fixture, not universal product detection performance. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Scans occur at 0 and 300 seconds; ten changes begin at 120, with six lasting to 360 and four reverting at 180. The 300-second scan sees six changes, yielding 60% fixture visibility; four reverted states do not imply no changes occurred.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Plaso log2timeline：解析器覆蓋、錯誤帳本與可重跑擷取
related.titleEn: Plaso log2timeline: parser coverage, error ledgers and reproducible extraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四列事件、窗口真值表、後端查詢差異及跨租戶反例，將實驗窗口定義列於每張結果表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver four event rows, interval truth tables, backend-query differences and cross-tenant counterexamples, printing the interval definition with results.
related.difference: 為每個虛構來源檔保留識別碼、雜湊、解析器選擇、成功狀態及錯誤；建立可由同一來源重跑的命令規格，不需安裝Plaso才能完成算例。
related.differenceEn: Preserve identifier, hash, parser selection, outcome and error for every fictional source file. Write a reproducible extraction specification; the arithmetic fixture must remain runnable without installing Plaso.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課使用(t−W,t]，而非假定所有後端都一致；tenant必須加入分組以避免相同帳號名跨租戶合併。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 租戶A同一user在0、59、60秒各有一筆，租戶B在60秒也有同名user；於t=60、W=60評估。 A窗口為(0,60]，只計59與60兩筆；B事件不得加入A的計數。

log2timeline擷取事件、pinfo與psort處理儲存與輸出；一個來源可產生多事件，所以檔案覆蓋與事件數是不同指標。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 來源100個，80成功、12未支援、8失敗；成功來源產生4000事件。指定工具版本、解析器清單及每次執行的獨立輸出名稱。 已成功擷取的來源覆蓋為80/100=80%；平均每個成功來源50事件不能用來推論其餘20個來源的內容。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: This exercise uses (t−W,t], without assuming universal backend behavior; tenant belongs in the grouping key. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Tenant A has same-user events at 0,59,60 seconds; tenant B has a same-named user at 60; evaluate at t=60 with W=60. A’s window is (0,60], counting only the events at 59 and 60; tenant B contributes nothing to A.

log2timeline extracts events while pinfo and psort support storage inspection and output. One source can produce many events, so file coverage and extracted event count must be reported separately. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 source files: 80 successful, 12 unsupported and eight failed, producing 4,000 events from successful inputs. Pin tool version, parser list and a separate output name for every run. Successful source coverage is 80/100=80%. The average of 50 events per successful source gives no evidence about the content of the other twenty sources.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
